summary: Algoma Steel Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 16, 2026, furnishing a media release dated October 15, 2026, announcing that its 2026 third-quarter financial results will be released after market close on October 28, 2026, with a webcast and conference call on October 29, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. ET.
